title: Business Gold Rewards Card: Earning 2.5% Cash Back on Operations Spending
summary: Explains Business Gold Rewards Card cash back rates: eligible operations purchases earn 2.5%, while non-operations spending earns 1.0%, based on the merchant category code. Rewards post after transactions clear; returns/credits reduce cash back in the same statement period where possible, and reclassification reviews are available via support.
